page.overview:
Who is Alois Tybur?

Alois is a young boy with dark hair. Like his brothers, he is seen wearing dress clothes.

When the Tybur family arrives in Liberio following the Marley Mid-East War, Alois joins his family to take up residence within the headquarters.
